parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How many playlists to return, from 1 to 100. 25 by default.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: How many to skip from the start of the list, to read further down it. 0 by default.
parameters.name: offset

offset.description: How many were skipped from the newest.

algorithm.description: For a generated playlist, which kind it is, such as daily-jams or weekly-exploration. Empty for one a person made.

collaborators.description: Other users who can edit it.

created_at.description: When it was made, as an ISO 8601 UTC time.

created_for.description: Who a generated playlist was made for.

creator.description: Who made it: a username, or troi-bot and listenbrainz for playlists ListenBrainz generated.

playlist_mbid.description: The playlist's ID. Pass it to 'Get playlist'.

total.description: How many playlists there are in all.

description: Read anyone's public listening history on ListenBrainz, MetaBrainz's open alternative to Last.fm: their listens and what is playing now, top artists, albums and tracks for any period, listening activity, loved tracks, similar listeners and followers, playlists (including the ones ListenBrainz generates), site-wide charts, new releases from the artists they play, and track and artist details from MusicBrainz. A trigger runs a workflow for every new listen. No account or API key required.

listenbrainz_new_listen_trigger.description: Runs when a ListenBrainz user records a new listen, with the track, artist, album, cover art and when it was played.

parameters.description: The ListenBrainz user whose listens to watch, as in listenbrainz.org/user/<name>.
parameters.name: username
